task: Simplify ProfilePage section dropdown formatting, gate Manuscript Document card to template unlock, and position Beneficiaries/Impact below Unique Innovation in CreateProjectPage
summary: Implemented three key UX refinements based on user feedback and screenshots: (1) Resolved confusing repetitive section dropdown label in ProfilePage by formatting options cleanly as BSIT-4A (2025-2026). (2) Gated the working Manuscript Document card on TeamsPage so that in Proposal Stage it is locked until the institutional Capstone Manuscript Template unlocks after title approval. (3) Repositioned Target Users / Beneficiaries and Expected Value / Impact directly beneath Unique Technical Innovation on CreateProjectPage.
